title: What to collect before an App Store submission
tagline: The list to send the client on day one, so release week is not spent waiting.
intro: App Store Connect asks for a dozen things only the client can decide. Collect them early; the build is rarely what delays a release.

sections.title: Overview
sections.summary: Who decides what, and when it is needed.

blocks.caption: From the first meeting to Submit for Review.

items.label: Identity
items.detail: Bundle id, name and version are fixed early; the bundle id can never change after release
explain: The bundle id, e.g. com.client.shop, is burned into the build and the store record. Ask whether the client wants to choose it; otherwise we do.
The app name must be unique on the store, so have a second choice ready before creating the record.

items.label: Store listing
items.detail: Subtitle, description, keywords and promotional text are the words the store shows
explain: The subtitle sits under the name in search results. Keywords are never shown, only searched, and are limited to 100 characters.
Promotional text can be changed any time without a new build; the description cannot.

items.label: Links and legal
items.detail: Support URL and privacy policy URL are required; the marketing URL is optional
explain: The privacy policy must be a live public page. A static page per app, like the policies on this site, is enough.
Copyright is a line such as '2026 Client Co., Ltd.', and the contact is a real person's name, phone and email for Apple's reviewers.

items.label: Screenshots and rating
items.detail: Up to 10 screenshots per device size, plus the age rating questionnaire
explain: Ask the client which screens to show, or capture them all and let them choose. Screenshots need test data that looks real.
The age rating comes from a questionnaire about content such as violence or gambling, not from a number you type.

sections.title: The list to send
sections.summary: Everything App Store Connect will ask for.

items: Bundle id — the client's choice, or ours
Version number — the client's choice, or ours
Marketing URL — the product site or the client's site
